title: Tie risk
description: Whether this venue's market is close enough to its strike for the tie rule to matter. Each venue settles a tie differently, so near a tie one side gets a small edge.

near_tie.label: Near a tie
near_tie.description: Yes when the price is within the venue's tie threshold of the strike. Yes means the tie rule could decide the round.

tie_advantage_side.label: Tie favours
tie_advantage_side.description: Which side wins if the price settles exactly on the strike under this venue's rule. Worth a cent or two when near a tie.
